newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton falls on new arrivals, poor interest.
newsitem.headline: India cotton falls on new arrivals, poor interest.

text.p: Cotton prices dropped further on the local market on Friday, dealers said, as higher new crop arrivals and sluggish mill buying dragged prices downward.
"New crop arrivals in the producing centres remained low last week due to cold weather but now again arrivals are picking up," one broker said. Overall volumes were at low ebb.
Arrivals in Punjab rose to 25,000/30,000 bales (170 kg each) against the daily average of 15,000/20,000 bales last week.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi slid five rupees to 775/820 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while F-414 fell by the same margin at 1,810/1,830 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 100 rupees to 11,400/11,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
